bull.b: A platform centered on gamma-delta (γδ) T cells represents a durable competitive asset: it targets hard-to-treat solid tumors and hematologic malignancies, supports multiple product modalities (engagers and cell therapies), and creates optionality across indications that can reduce single-program binary risk.

bull.t: Compelling glioblastoma clinical data and safety
bull.b: Large PFS improvement and an encouraging safety profile are structurally material for a development-stage biotech: they can materially de-risk the GBM program, support regulatory engagement and accelerated pathways, and strengthen the company’s negotiating position for partnerships or licensing.

bull.t: Improving cash position and financial flexibility
bull.b: A stronger cash balance and narrower losses versus prior periods extend runway and allow continued clinical development. Combined with evidence of reduced burn versus 2022–2024, this trend meaningfully lowers near-term financing pressure and supports execution on upcoming clinical/regulatory milestones.

bear.t: No commercial revenue and persistent net losses
bear.b: Absence of product revenue means the company’s value and sustainability depend entirely on R&D success and external funding. Persistent multi‑million dollar losses make profitability distant, constrain reinvestment capacity, and create structural risk if clinical milestones slip or capital markets tighten.

bear.t: Negative operating and free cash flow
bear.b: Sustained negative free cash flow requires repeated capital raises to fund development. This structural cash shortfall increases dilution risk, limits strategic optionality, and can force prioritization of programs, potentially slowing clinical timelines or reducing pipeline breadth if financing becomes constrained.

bear.t: Ongoing reliance on equity capital markets (ATM programs)
bear.b: Dependence on at-the-market equity facilities is a durable funding strategy but signals limited internal cash generation and persistent need to access public markets. ATMs provide flexibility but increase dilution risk and expose development plans to market conditions and execution timing constraints.
